_comment: Corpus for the mock threat feed. Indicators here line up with fixtures/indicators.json
so a learner can pivot from an alert in #alerts straight into /threat <indicator>.
alert-006 references 198.51.100.23, which the intel API deliberately 404s. Module 4's
second check uses it to require graceful handling of a miss.

alerts.title: Emotet C2 beacon observed
alerts.detail: Host 10.14.22.8 sustained 43 outbound connections to a known Emotet controller in 6 minutes.

alerts.title: Ransomware loader executed
alerts.detail: BlackBasta loader executed from %TEMP% on FIN-WKS-114 and attempted shadow copy deletion.

alerts.title: Adversary in the middle phishing portal
alerts.detail: Nine staff submitted credentials to a proxy portal impersonating the SSO login page.

alerts.title: Fake browser update delivery
alerts.detail: SocGholish injection served a fake update prompt to 4 hosts in the marketing subnet.

alerts.title: Infostealer artefact quarantined
alerts.detail: LummaStealer sample quarantined on ENG-WKS-070 after clipboard hooking was detected.

alerts.title: Unclassified long lived tunnel
alerts.detail: A 5 hour encrypted session to an address with no current intel coverage.

alerts.title: Cobalt Strike named pipe signature
alerts.detail: Beacon traffic matching a Cobalt Strike malleable profile seen from OPS-SRV-03.

alerts.title: Credential lure campaign
alerts.detail: 31 messages carrying an invoice themed lure linking to a staged AgentTesla dropper.

alerts.title: Opportunistic port scan
alerts.detail: Sequential scan across 1024 ports from a low reputation source. No response permitted.

alerts.title: Unrecognised telemetry endpoint
alerts.detail: Low volume periodic callbacks to a domain registered 9 days ago. Benign so far.

alerts.title: EICAR style test detection
alerts.detail: A test sample tripped the on access scanner during scheduled control validation.

alerts.title: Emotet dropper on a domain controller
alerts.detail: Dropper executed under a service account on DC-02. Lateral movement attempts followed.
